fusions.name: Last Mile
fusions.desc: A finishing blow that deals 14 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%). Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Wear Them Down
fusions.desc: Harries every enemy within 3 tiles: it deals 10 damage, strips 12% armour for 6 seconds, slows each by 25% and knocks each back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Trotting Pace
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Warmed Up
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
